about.title: Our Church
about.heroQuote: Let us consider how to spur one another on toward love and good deeds, not giving up meeting together.
about.heroSubtitle: A community of faith in Saint-Hippolyte-du-Fort
about.missionText: The Reformed Evangelical Church La Chapelle is a Christian community committed to serving the people of Saint-Hippolyte-du-Fort. Our mission is to welcome everyone, share God's love, and build a community founded on faith, hope, and charity.
about.visionText: We aspire to be a place of refuge and spiritual renewal in Saint-Hippolyte-du-Fort, where every person can discover their place in God's family, grow in faith, and serve others with love.
about.historyText: Born from a vision to gather believers, our church established itself in Saint-Hippolyte-du-Fort. Since our beginnings, we have grown as a multicultural and multilingual community, welcoming people from all walks of life.

god.title: One God
god.text: We believe in one God, creator of all things, eternally existing in three persons: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

bible.title: Holy Scripture
bible.text: We believe the Bible is the inspired and infallible Word of God, the supreme authority for faith and life.

jesus.title: Jesus Christ
jesus.text: We believe in Jesus Christ, truly God and truly man, the only Savior and Lord, who died for our sins and rose again.

spirit.title: Holy Spirit
spirit.text: We believe in the transformative power of the Holy Spirit, who dwells in every believer and guides the Church.

about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide our community

welcome.title: Unconditional Welcome
welcome.description: We open our doors to everyone, without distinction, because every person is precious in God's eyes.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.description: We cultivate honest and transparent relationships, grounded in truth and mutual respect.

service.title: Service
service.description: We serve one another and our community with generosity, following Christ's example of humility.

prayer.title: Prayer
prayer.description: Prayer is the heartbeat of our community, the foundation upon which everything else is built.

teaching.title: Biblical Teaching
teaching.description: We are committed to faithful, relevant teaching of Scripture that transforms hearts and minds.

fellowship.title: Fellowship
fellowship.description: We nurture deep bonds of brotherhood, sharing joys and burdens as one family in Christ.

team.subtitle: Servant leaders guiding our community with love and dedication
